IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Pearson, O'Brien, Ericks, Fromhold, Ross, Sells and Moeller

Bill.BriefDescription: Doubling the amount of monetary penalties for traffic infractions on high accident corridors.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to monetary penalties for traffic infractions onhigh accident corridors; adding a new section to chapter 46.61 RCW;prescribing penalties; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.61 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The amount of any monetary penalty prescribed by state law,administrative rule, or court rule, whether civil or criminal innature, for traffic infractions on any state highway with at leastforty miles of high accident corridors as designated by the departmentof transportation shall be doubled. (2) Monetary penalties imposed under subsection (1) of this sectionshall be distributed as follows: (a) Sixty percent shall be deposited in the motor vehicle accountsolely for safety improvements along state highways with at least fortymiles of high accident corridors; (b) Thirty percent to the Washington traffic safety commission forsafety education regarding state highways with at least forty miles ofhigh accident corridors; p. 1 HB 1655 (c) Ten percent to county prosecutors of counties where the trafficinfractions occurred for additional court costs.
This act expires two years after theeffective date of this act.
